envipco-holding-envip-xosl.author: Pengesluk 2.0
envipco-holding-envip-xosl.text: Nok en «ordre» i UK. Nå må snart kursen begynne å gå. Milevis foran Tomra i UK atm.  has been selected as one of two preferred suppliers of RVMs to a leading UK food and drink wholesaler. The wholesaler supplies into thousands of retail locations across the United Kingdom supporting a broad network of independent convenience and grocery retailers. Under the preferred supplier arrangement, Envipco will offer its portfolio of reverse vending solutions to participating retailers preparing for the introduction of the UK's upcoming Deposit Return Scheme (DRS), scheduled for launch 1 October 2027. The selection reflects Envipco's proven technology, strong customer support capabilities, and extensive experience supporting deposit return systems across multiple international markets. Group CEO José Matthijsse commented: "We are pleased to have been selected as a preferred supplier by this leading UK wholesale retail group. This relationship strengthens our position in the UK market and expands our reach into a significant network of independent retailers as preparations for DRS implementation continue. We look forward to supporting retailers with efficient, reliable, and consumer-friendly recycling solutions." The commercial impact of the arrangement is expected to develop progressively as participating retailers evaluate and deploy reverse vending equipment ahead of DRS implementation.
